recipe.title: Intellectual Lineage
recipe.purpose: Trace how ideas, methods, or styles pass through people, schools, and generations.
recipe.groupingLogic: Groups should be lineages, handoff points, or influence chains with attention to inheritance and mutation.
recipe.contributorRules: Contributors should appear where their work changes, transmits, or redirects the lineage.
recipe.generationInstructions: Emphasize influence, divergence, continuity, and discontinuity. Preserve chronology where it clarifies structure.
